inputs.name: registerResponseCheckCommand.program
inputs.description: The commander `Command` on which the function creates the `response-check` subcommand, via `program.command('response-check')`. The function does no validation of it and uses it only for that one `command` call.

outputs.name: registerResponseCheckCommand
outputs.description: The function returns nothing: it is declared `void` and has no return statement, so callers get no subcommand handle back. Its effect is registering the `response-check` subcommand, with its options, description and action, on the program passed in.
